description: Power system small-signal modelling tool in MATLAB is a software deposit deposited in borq.00001-2020 by its authors Luke Benedetti, Agusti Egea (University of Manchester). This repository contains the MATLAB scripts for creating a power system small-signal model. A modular and automatic compilation approach is adopted requiring only parameter data (in the format observed in the examples folder) and a MATPOWER case file to create an interconnected power system small-signal model. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 76344 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
